title: Bump agnix-core 0.54.0 → 0.56.1 in osf
summary: A dependency-only change: the osf crate pins agnix-core to 0.56.1 (from 0.54.0), which drags agnix-rules to 0.56.2 and rewrites the corresponding Cargo.lock entries. No source code changes, so the runtime graph is untouched — what moves is the version of the lint/rule engine that osf links against at build time.
